propositions: Test test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer kills pytest-xdist worker on macOS due to exceeding 300s per-test timeout budget
Single monolithic test function processes entire corpus of 884 renderable units sequentially (~1768 pandoc spawns), taking 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU contention, exceeding the 300s guard
pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from timer thread, terminating worker process with no traceback instead of failing the test
Parametrizing test with fixed-size chunks (_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) bounds individual test cost to ~4.2s idle with 13x headroom under contention while maintaining byte-identity verification
New test test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit validates all 884 units are covered by chunks and total >= 100 to prevent silent unit drops
